name: What types of molding are typically installed in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What types of molding are typically installed in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen molding installation involves measuring, precision-cutting, fitting, and securing decorative trim to finish cabinet tops, ceilings, and base walls. Common types include crown molding along the upper cabinetry or ceiling, light rail molding beneath upper cabinets to hide under-cabinet fixtures, toe kicks along the base, and scribe molding to conceal gaps against uneven walls. A key decision factor is ceiling alignment; uneven drywall or settling often requires two-piece compound molding or a riser block so the trim sits flush without visible gaps. Working with a finish contractor ensures joints are tight, coped, caulked, and matched seamlessly to the existing cabinet or trim paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen molding includes crown molding on cabinets and ceilings, light rails under upper cabinets, baseboard trim, and scribe molding to conceal uneven gaps.
